text.en: Scaling ViT is row 3 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: Scaling ViT 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 3 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates Scaling ViT with “Scaling vision transformers”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Scaling ViT 与论文《Scaling vision transformers》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Xiaohua Zhai, Alexander Kolesnikov,Lucas Beyer”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 翟晓华、亚历山大·科列斯尼科夫、卢卡斯·拜尔；官方英文原文为“Xiaohua Zhai, Alexander Kolesnikov,Lucas Beyer”。

text.en: Xiaohua Zhai, Alexander Kolesnikov and Lucas Beyer, the three main contributors named by BenchCouncil, are all authors of the CVPR paper; the full paper author list additionally includes Neil Houlsby.
text.zh: BenchCouncil 列出的三位主要人物翟晓华、亚历山大·科列斯尼科夫和卢卡斯·拜尔均为 CVPR 论文作者；完整论文作者表还包括尼尔·霍尔斯比。

text.en: The study spans models from about 5 million to 2 billion parameters, datasets from 1 million to 3 billion images, and compute from below one to over 10,000 TPUv3 core-days; its performance-compute frontier is approximated by a saturating power law.
text.zh: 研究覆盖约 500 万到 20 亿参数、100 万到 30 亿张图像，以及不足 1 到超过 1 万 TPUv3 core-days 的算力范围；性能与算力前沿可近似为逐渐饱和的幂律。

text.en: The paper combines a memory-efficient ViT training recipe with ViT-G/14, reporting 90.45% ImageNet top-1 accuracy and 84.86% top-1 with 10 examples per class in linear evaluation.
text.zh: 论文把更节省内存的 ViT 训练方案用于 ViT-G/14，报告 90.45% 的 ImageNet top-1 准确率，以及每类 10 个样本线性评估下 84.86% 的 top-1 准确率。
